timing_selection: Only after a nominee passes the development and stress gates, run ordinary Full4, Full5 and Full6 cleanly on the three development windows and original seeds 42/43/44. Reuse the identical current Full10 runs. Use only synchronized scene time per model receipt. For each k, take the mean over rooms of median paired ordinary seconds divided by median candidate seconds. The largest tested k with ratio <=1 is affordable. If Full4 exceeds budget, also run Full1,2,3, retaining all original grid entries. Missing times do not establish affordability; if no tested integer fits, retain the fastest measured comparison descriptively and disclose that no time match exists.
holdout: One ZERO forward at seed 7 per visit produces two dense outputs, native VGGT and VGGT depth rescaled by positive median rig/predicted camera-baseline ratio and unprojected with supplied cameras and K. CPU scoring starts only after both predictions are sealed. Keep the first lexicographically sorted visit for the independent ZERO and supplied-readout rescores. Both readouts share the model time; add only the actual projection overhead for the supplied readout and use its own postprojection peak.
gates: Quality primary ratios are candidate / Full10 directed mean distances, with accuracy <=1.01, completeness <=1.03 and scene time <1. Full40 stretch separately uses candidate / control scene time <=.25 and peak allocated <=.764. Cold, placement, reserved peaks and host costs are descriptive. For the chosen ordinary-k comparator show actual fresh time ratio and one-sided paired bounds, and superiority against 1.0 for each geometry error separately. A strict equal-budget Pareto claim requires upper bounds below 1 for both geometry errors and <=1 for candidate/control time. Do not infer equal time from development matching or impose an after-the-fact time band.
controls: Parameter- and schedule-matched Refresh1/Refresh1Uncached and where measured Narrow/NarrowUncached isolate reuse. If applicable compare Distilled/OfflineOriginal for teacher specificity and both against standard Cache10; fewer trainable parameters or a lower allocation do not alone demonstrate capacity. Include terminal counts, OOMs and all other failures under the common cap.
retrospective: Archived original zero, four/five-step controls, full 10, full 40 and cached 10 furnish within-study comparisons for development and each transfer dataset as available. When input/reference hashes match, compare current development geometry descriptively to archived controls, recording the run generation and loader. Do not mix generations for formal resource gates, borrow historical transfer conclusions for a new hybrid, or claim a new time match without measurements. A six-visit blind test is conditional on a positive nomination.
